title: Mechanosynthesis of a bismuth nanoparticle-decorated palm kernel mesocarp fiber (Bi-PKMF): adsorption of Pb(II), kinetics and thermodynamics

A new bismuth-decorated palm kernel mesocarp fiber (Bi-PKMF) adsorbent was prepared through green liquid-assisted mechano-chemical grinding, followed by thermal crystallization.
